title: Machine for recognizing even parity
statement: Consider the finite Turing machine with no work tapes, Boolean states, and initial state true. It moves the input head to the right on each input symbol, toggles its state on a true bit and leaves its state unchanged on a false bit; when it reaches the end of the input, it outputs its current state and halts.
